wish: someone should make a site that builds a personal CV website
spec:
Builds a one-page personal CV website from your name, links, about, jobs, schools, projects and skills.
Fill the fields and watch the live preview; tap Download site to save it as a single self-contained index.html you can host anywhere.
It does not host the site for you, import from LinkedIn, or send your details anywhere; drafts stay in this browser.
notes: Download uses a local blob link; the exported page has no external requests.
